title: The weDocs: AI Powered Knowledge Base, Docs, Documentation, Wiki & AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The weDocs WordPress plugin up to version 2.6.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'modalPlaceholder' block attribute. Authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when admins or editors preview or view the affected posts. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
